neighbours.label: an elliptical tag that rounds off a clause as an afterthought ('and all', 'and counting', ', tops', 'or what', 'on camera and off'), not the same word used as a full argument
fire: The hotel was nice and all, but the beach was too far away.
The repair should take an hour, tops.
Our little club has raised ten thousand pounds and counting.
Is this the best pie you have ever tasted or what!
She is funny on camera and off.
He has coached three champions and counting.
You will wait five minutes for a table, tops.
I liked the lecture and all, but it ran far too long.
quiet: The hotel was nice, but the beach was too far away.
The repair should take about an hour.
Our little club has raised ten thousand pounds this year.
Is this the best pie you have ever tasted?
She is funny when the camera is off.
He has coached three champions in ten years.
You will wait five minutes for a table on a busy night.
I liked all of the lecture except the ending.
